migration_and_preparation.scope: Exact legacy IDs and preferences, preserved third-party entries, 20 migration repetitions, 100 serialized writes, registration updates while download lock is held; 100 readiness waiters, caller cancellation and explicit profile precedence.

install_pair.flow: Install/check/restore-uninstall/reinstall/check/detach-uninstall/reinstall/check; documents, preferences and original backup preserved; payload cleaned.

uninstall_regressions.scope: Failure, cancellation, rollback and retained user data; payload cleaned.

corrected_failures: The initial independent registry omitted the shared locale setter required by the service loader, blocking native startup. The loader contract was restored and the final native fixture passed.
Moving an installed list row between groups lost keyboard focus. The view now preserves node identity, selection and focus, including 100 progress updates.
Returning from community settings lost the selected catalog section. The neutral Extensions shell now forwards that section to its owner.
Clear could race with retry. Removal now owns a per-language busy state and rejects conflicting writes; native regression passed.
The test wrapper inherited PowerShell Core module paths into Windows PowerShell 5.1, hiding Get-FileHash. Final tests used a process-local native PSModulePath; no machine setting was changed.

local_install.uninstall_preflight: Read-only detach; actual user environment was not uninstalled.
local_install.running_windows: Not closed or restarted. Save documents and restart all Typora windows to load; legacy migration and automatic preparation occur at that startup.

limits: Managed downloads currently target Windows x64. Other platforms and complete SDK/build/debug environments are not validated here.

Current native validation uses a real CMake server and synthetic DOM actions/F12; arbitrary dynamic Zephyr variables depend on server/project context, and full VS Code extension equivalence is not claimed.
All nine clean-PATH recipe checks belong to release 2026.10.04.1; this turn reran real CMake automatic setup, not every external download. See language_setup_20261004.json.
UI fixtures use the production view with a controlled service; native evidence separately verifies actual download and navigation.
Only seven related UI suites were run, not the full UI library. Historical black-screen, clipping, dual-native-editor and fenced-code native-return issues remain open.
